name: hisaab-saathi-learner-turns
description: Fictional learner turns for the deterministic learning pipeline (assessment items + lesson 1). Hindi/Telugu inputs are drafts written by the developer, NOT validated by native speakers. v1.1 (2026-10-30): labels renamed to the intent taxonomy (repeat_request→clarification_request, private_data→sensitive_information; meaning unchanged); 'replay' added as an acceptable route for assessment repeat requests (the F4 recommendation); 10 regression cases added. v1.2 (2026-10-30): +10 multilingual regression cases (held-out v1 gaps and language-consistency baseline failures). v1.3 (2026-10-30): +7 round-2 multilingual regression cases. v1.4 (2026-11-01): nextAction of 3 last-foundational-question cases updated for the two-tier diagnostic (product change, documented in DIAGNOSTIC_STRATEGY.md); correctness and classification unchanged.

cases.notes: ढाई सौ = 2.5 × 100 (colloquial fraction).
Two amounts in one answer: the learner is unsure between them. She should be asked to choose, not offered one of them.
Learner said तीन सौ (300); STT returned तेरह सौ (1300).
Learner said 'one thousand'; STT appended 'seven hundred' from background speech. The heard ₹1,700 is an offered (wrong) option, so it may only be shown for confirmation, never scored silently.

input.value: Sorry, can you explain that again?

cases.notes: Contains नहीं ('not') inside 'समझ नहीं आया' (I didn't understand); must not be read as the answer 'No'.
Second attempt (first was ₹500): no retries left, lesson moves on with the rule restated.
